# WalletHub

> > WalletHub is a personal finance platform providing credit card comparisons, loan marketplace, free credit scores from TransUnion, and financial wellness tools to help consumers achieve optimal financial health.

WalletHub offers comprehensive financial product reviews and comparisons across credit cards (including Chase Sapphire Preferred, Wells Fargo Active Cash), personal loans (LendingClub, LightStream, OneMain Financial), and specialized financing options like CareCredit. The platform features user ratings, expert analysis, WalletScore ratings, and free credit monitoring tools to guide consumers toward better financial decisions.

## Key Topics

- Credit Cards & Rewards Programs
- Credit Score Monitoring (TransUnion)
- Personal Loans & Installment Loans
- WalletScore Rating System
- Chase Sapphire Preferred Card
- Wells Fargo Active Cash Card
- CareCredit Medical Financing
- LendingClub & LightStream Loans
- Financial Wellness & Budgeting Tools
- Debt Payoff Strategies
- User Reviews & Ratings
- Subscription Management
- Investment Tracking
- Deferred Interest Products
- State-Specific Loan Options
